system.description: The character can make a mirage appear in à group's mind.
system.effect: The character creates a full-sensory mirage that affects everyone in a Telepathic Network they set up who is also in the same locale. The mirage can be of anything the character desires, and it can move freely.

outcomes.label: Describe the full-sensory mirage and confirm every selected target belongs to the character's active Telepathic Network and is in the same locale.
